purpose: Connect companionship, simultaneous change, or two coexisting aspects.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Noun / verb dictionary form / い-adjective / な-adjectiveである + と共に
I moved to a new town with my family.
Language changes as the times change.
Graduating makes me happy and also a little sad.
formation: Noun / verb dictionary form / い-adjective / な-adjectiveである + と共に
restrictions: With change verbs it means as; with people it means together with.
mistake: For everyday invitations, と一緒に is usually more conversational.
